description: This Java source file defines the ParameterOptionVisitor class, which implements the OptionVisitor interface. It processes different options related to search queries, such as limit, sort, cursor, and size, to build or modify a QueryBuilder object accordingly. The class is used within a query parameter parsing context in a broader search or query system.

classes.name: ParameterOptionVisitor
classes.description: A visitor class for processing search query options, translating them into query builder modifications.
